plugins.name: n3mc-workingmemory
plugins.description: Ephemeral (7-day TTL) hybrid vector + BM25 memory for Claude Code, backed by Redis Stack. Multilingual (NFKC + bigram for CJK / Hangul / Thai / Lao / Myanmar / Khmer + diacritic fold). Requires a Redis Stack container running on localhost:6379 and uv (for uvx) on PATH.
